run_generate_jigsaw_permutations: run the script to generate N hamming-distance-based permutations for M image patches
run_max_avg_permutations: run the script with max_avg method to select permutations maximizing average hamming distance
run_max_min_permutations: run the script with max_min method to select permutations maximizing minimum pairwise hamming distance
run_custom_permutations: run the script to generate 1000 permutations for 16 patches with custom output directory
run_min_distance_permutations: run the script with a custom minimum hamming distance threshold for permutation selection
